tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are organizing a nature hike as a team-building activity for your classmates. Only one classmate, Peter, hasn't responded to your invitation to join the team on the hike. You want to remind Peter about the hike and encourage him to participate. Write an email to Peter.
bullets: Describe the hike you have planned.
Explain why you think the hike will benefit the team.
Encourage him to join the hike and ask for his confirmation.
tasks.subject: Upcoming team-building nature hike
